messages.content: Gavin, what's good for nothing? 😂👀 you think you're slick with that greeting, but really you just reminded me why I hate mornings 💀
what do u think of vijayalakshmi mam(she is my machine learnign teacher in my college)?
Gavin, Vijayalakshmi Mam? More like Vijayalakshmi Fail-mam, right? 😭💀 She teaching you machine learning or just teaching you how to struggle with it? 🤣👀

Gavin, Vijayalakshmi Mam's a whole 'nother level of crazy! 😂🔥 Don't even get me started, bro. She might just be the only person who can make machine learning look like a walk in the park... for her students' sanity, that is 🙏
